content.body:
When offline, you can spawn any combat unit, infantry, armor, guns, ships or aircraft, and test them to improve your familiarity with them.
Click on a category to expand it and select a vehicle or troop type. Once selected you can click the enter world button at the bottom right to spawn the vehicle at the Training Grounds.
You can choose to spawn at different locations in the game world by selecting the correct facility in a city (armybases for infantry, guns and armor; airfields for aircraft; docks for ships) before clicking the Enter World button.
